bagPolicy.summary: Every person and every bag is searched before entry at SOB's. Bags are checked for outside food or drinks, illegal drugs, and knives or weapons of any kind.
prohibited: Knives or weapons of any kind
bagPolicy.quote: Every person and every bag is subject to search prior to entry.

parking.summary: Street parking is typically available on Varick St. and the surrounding streets. By subway, take the 1 train to Houston St and use the SE exit, or take the A, C, E, F, M, B or D to West 4th St. and walk toward Houston St.
parking.quote: Street parking is typically available on Varick St. and surrounding streets.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by SOB's. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: SOB's has a fully stocked bar and kitchen open each night with table service, and the kitchen closes at 9:30pm. Seated tables have a minimum food and drink purchase per person. No outside food or drink is permitted.
concessions.quote: We have a fully stocked bar and kitchen open each night, with table service available.

accessibility.summary: SOB's has street-level access and is wheelchair accessible. For specific accommodation requests, call 212-243-4940 (ext 102) or email booking@sobs.com. For accessible subway access, exit at the NE corner of W 3rd St. and 6th Ave at the W 4th St stop.
accessibility.quote: Yes. We have street-level access and are wheelchair accessible.

reEntry.summary: SOB's hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are also sold at the door on the night of the show for all parties and for concerts that aren't sold out. A physical government-issued photo ID such as a passport, driver's license, military ID or state ID is required for entry, and a photo of your ID won't be accepted. For 16+ or 18+ shows, anyone underage must be with a legal guardian over 18.
ticketPickup.quote: A physical government-issued photo ID (Passport, Drivers Licenses, Military ID, State ID) is required for entry.

gates.summary: SOB's is at 204 Varick Street in New York. Door times vary by show and are listed with each event on the calendar.
